name: y86-pipeline-visualizer
description: Y86-64 pipelined and sequential CPU visualizer (Verilog + Node + React)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: make -C hardware test && node --test shared/test tests && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
